message: 大人の本
Leaving the entrance of the new school building, I head straight for the library.
With less than a month until the Holy Night Festival, the Student Council is swamped.
As if in response, the Demons are showing ominous signs of activity too, keeping us constantly on guard.
And then, there's Re-Crea--
I'd looked into the Demons at the library before, though I didn't turn up anything noteworthy.
There's no harm in trying, so today I'll go look for any books written about Re-Crea.

name: Helena
message: 「You're a lifesaver, Melilot. I haven't had the time to look for one myself.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Think nothing of it. Here you are--this is my top recommendation for a mystery novel.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, looks intriguing. What kind of story is it?」
When I arrived, Melilot-san was handing a paperback book to Helena-san in front of the library.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello. Do you like detective stories, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, I'm Helena, the woman who nibbles on any wonderful story regardless of genre.\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Chuckle*...」

name: Helena
message: 「Aww, how mean~. You're supposed to chime in and say I have no restraint.」

name: Melilot
message: 「How one engages with books varies from person to person. While there may be right ways, there are no wrong ones.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't read enough to puff out my chest and call myself a reader...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? I've been reading all sorts of books since before my boobs even puffed out, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Th-That's admirable, but couldn't you phrase it differently? Good grief.」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see...」

name: Helena
message: 「The very first night I ever stayed up till dawn, I was reading a detective novel.」

name: Helena
message: 「Greeting the morning without having slept.」

name: Helena
message: 「Just from that alone, I felt like I wasn't a child anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! I felt the exact same way the first time I pulled an all-nighter.」

name: Helena
message: 「The night was much longer than I'd imagined. Plenty long enough for Santa Claus to walk around handing out presents.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Fufu, that's quite a charming comparison coming from you, Helena.」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, Synn-chan. I'm really looking forward to the Holy Night Festival, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh...! I'll do my very best.」

name: Melilot
message: 「S-So that was just a setup to put pressure on Sakura-kun...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well come ooon, Synn-chan, you came to the library, didn't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Which means you're gonna spend some fun time together with Melilot... What's wrong with me getting a tiny bit jealous and teasing you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will not do anything weird with Sakura-kun!」

name: Helena
message: 「Something weird? I only said a warm, exciting little moment, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Do you mean that for you, Helena-san, while you like books, the time spent choosing them is just as delightful?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ding-dong♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena... I understand that feeling.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, and I love the gentle smile you have when you're reading a book in the library, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「H-Hey! Isn't that embarrassing...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Whaaat, are you blushing?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, and also. I love your profile lit up by the reading lamp, and the shape of your hand pointing at the bookshelves. I can picture it even with my eyes closed.」

name: Melilot
message: 「T-The culprit in that novel is Yasu! The protagonist's assistant!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa... What a massive spoiler...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, it's fine, okay? You can figure out the culprit right away from the pacing and the phrasing of the dialogue anyway.」

name: Helena
message: 「Rather, I find the charm in the process of deduction and the back-and-forth between the characters.」

name: Helena
message: 「See ya, Synn-chan. I'm leaving you in charge of calming Melilot down!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That sounds harder than preparing for the Holy Night Festival, though...」
Parting ways with Helena-san, I headed into the library as if chasing after Melilot-san.
Without any need for me to calm her down, the moment Melilot-san started her librarian duties, she put on a calm and collected demeanor.
...There wasn't a single book about Re-Crea.
